statement: Annular variation and dyadic absolute bounds for the triangular Hilbert transform. Proves maximal and annular r-variation bounds, for every r > 2, from complex $`L^3(\mathbb R^2)\times L^3(\mathbb R^2)`$ to $`L^{3/2}(\mathbb R^2)`$. The maximal estimate controls both hard truncation endpoints and gives almost-everywhere and norm convergence. Pairing with a third input settles the triangular Hilbert transform estimate at the symmetric $`L^3\times L^3\times L^3`$ point.
